providers.label: chromedp headless-shell
providers.sessionSemantics: Connects to an already-running browser process and uses its default context.

providers.label: Playwright Chromium (baseline)
providers.engine: Playwright's own Chromium build and launch flags, via `playwright run-server`
providers.sessionSemantics: Each connection launches a new Chromium process with Playwright's default flags (Playwright protocol, not CDP).

providers.label: Browserless
providers.sessionSemantics: Each WebSocket connection launches a new Chromium process, which is killed on disconnect.

providers.label: Steel Browser
providers.engine: Chromium behind the Steel session API
providers.sessionSemantics: POST /v1/sessions relaunches Chromium with a clean profile; the client then connects over CDP. One session at a time.

providers.label: Obscura
providers.engine: Own Rust engine with V8 (not Chromium)
providers.sessionSemantics: Each CDP connection gets its own thread and V8 isolates inside one long-lived server process.

providers.label: Lightpanda
providers.engine: Own Zig engine with V8 (not Chromium, no rendering)
providers.sessionSemantics: Each CDP connection gets its own browser instance inside one server process.

providers.label: Camoufox
providers.engine: Patched Firefox (Playwright protocol, no CDP; driven by a Playwright 1.50 client)
providers.sessionSemantics: Connects to one long-lived Firefox through a Playwright server and creates a new context.
